text: Given a role-assignable group's id, When graph_get_group is called in the Microsoft Graph connector, Then the response includes isAssignableToRole: true.
Given an ordinary group's id, When graph_get_group is called in the Microsoft Graph connector, Then isAssignableToRole is not true (Graph's raw value, typically null, is passed through unchanged).
Given a role-assignable group in a GDAP customer tenant, When graph_get_group is called with that tenant's customer_tenant_id, Then the response includes isAssignableToRole: true.
Given an ordinary group in the same GDAP customer tenant, When graph_get_group is called with that customer_tenant_id, Then isAssignableToRole is not true.

Given graph_get_group is called in the Microsoft Graph connector, When the response is compared to today's shape, Then mailEnabled, securityEnabled, groupTypes, onPremisesSyncEnabled and sync_source are all still present and correct, alongside the new isAssignableToRole.

Given graph_get_group is called in the Microsoft 365 GDAP connector, When the response is compared to today's shape, Then mailEnabled, securityEnabled, groupTypes, onPremisesSyncEnabled and sync_source are all still present and correct, alongside the new isAssignableToRole.

Given a user who belongs to one role-assignable and one ordinary group, When graph_list_user_groups is called for that user in the Microsoft Graph connector, Then both group entries include the correct isAssignableToRole.

Given a user who belongs to one role-assignable and one ordinary group, When graph_list_user_groups is called for that user in the Microsoft 365 GDAP connector with customer_tenant_id, Then both group entries include the correct isAssignableToRole.

Given graph_list_user_groups is called across two pages in the Microsoft Graph connector, When the responses are compared to today's shape, Then has_more/next_page_token pagination and sync_source derivation are unchanged, alongside the new isAssignableToRole on every entry.

Given two different GDAP customer tenants each with their own role-assignable/ordinary groups, When graph_get_group and graph_list_user_groups are each called once per tenant with that tenant's customer_tenant_id, Then each call's isAssignableToRole values reflect only that tenant's own groups.

Given the real role-assignable test group in test tenant 2qmxyw (prerequisite tracked under PRD-21647's Test Prerequisite), When graph_get_group is called against it through both the Microsoft Graph and the Microsoft 365 GDAP connectors, Then both return isAssignableToRole: true from live Microsoft Graph.
steps: Confirm the role-assignable test group exists in tenant 2qmxyw (created under PRD-21647's Test Prerequisite)
Call graph_get_group against that group id through the Microsoft Graph (single-tenant) connector with a live access token
Call graph_get_group against the same group through the Microsoft 365 GDAP connector with customer_tenant_id=2qmxyw
expect: Both calls return isAssignableToRole: true for the known role-assignable group.
